concerns.text: FR-001 and US-1 explicitly mandate loading 'IMO/IPhO' datasets. Task T011 references 'math-olympiad' (unverified/ambiguous) and T012 implements a loader for 'ScienceQA' (derived from nvidia/OpenScience per plan) instead of the required IMO/IPhO dataset. This silently drops a core functional requirement, violating the spec's data acquisition constraints.

FR-004 and US-2 require a proxy model 'fine-tuned on a diverse set of general scientific reasoning' to ensure independence from SU-01. Task T020 configures `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct` (base instruct model) without specifying the required fine-tuning step or dataset. Using the base model violates the constraint that the scorer must be distinct from the training distribution.

Spec Edge Cases mandate a fallback to 'a smaller quantized model OR a distilled model' if the 8B model fails RAM constraints. Task T020 only implements a fallback to a 'distilled 3B model', omitting the 'smaller quantized' path (e.g., further quantization of the 8B or a different quantized variant) required by the spec's edge case handling.

FR-009 requires a power analysis to 'justify' that N=500 is sufficient. Task T033 is scoped only to 'verify sufficiency' on a fixed N=500. The task lacks the explicit output of a justification report or sensitivity analysis required to satisfy the 'justify' verb in the requirement, effectively weakening the deliverable from a justification to a simple check.
